mentions.name: Soonpatch
mentions.description: A tool that turns Slack report messages about code bugs or improvements into fixes: paste the report into Claude Code and it applies the fix in the proper repo/worktree right away. It can be invoked from any Claude Code instance and automatically locates the right repo/worktree without manual directory navigation.
mentions.problem: Manually navigating directories to apply Slack-reported code fixes in the correct repo/worktree is slow and error-prone; Soonpatch automates routing and applying the fix.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on https://soonpatch.com - to paste a slack report message about your code (bug/improvement) in Claude Code and get the fix in the proper repo/worktree right away (you can call it in any CC instance and it'll find the way, no need to navigate through your directories manually)
